name: High vibration mounting
condition: Pump outlet, compressor skid or conveyor frame where the mounting point vibrates continuously.
criteria: Prefer a rigid housing over a plastic one.
Route the cable with a service loop.
Photograph the installed routing so the next maintenance can restore it.
cautions: Avoid mounting directly on a resonating panel.
Re-check zero after the first thermal cycle; vibration plus heat loosens joints.
seoDescription: High vibration mounting: torque limits, rigid housings and cable routing for pump outlets, compressor skids and conveyor frames, with re-torque intervals.

zh.name: 振动环境安装
zh.condition: 泵出口、压缩机撬块或输送机机架等持续振动的安装点。
criteria: 优先金属外壳而不是塑料外壳。
把安装后的走线拍照留存，下次维护才能复原。
cautions: 不要直接装在共振面板上。
首次热循环后需复核零点——振动加温升会让接头松动。
zh.seoTitle: 振动环境安装：固定方式、限矩与线缆走向现场可用。
zh.seoDescription: 振动环境安装建议：螺纹连接需限矩安装，优先选用刚性金属外壳，线缆预留服务弯以避免疲劳断裂，并说明泵出口、压缩机撬块等点位的安装顺序与复紧周期。
